name: nori
description: Nori email client — Electron + Bun (React renderer in web/, Electron/Bun host in electron/)

scripts.dev: bun run dev:web & bun run dev:electron
scripts.dev:electron: cd electron && bun run build:main && ../node_modules/.bin/electron dist/main.cjs --dev
scripts.typecheck: cd web && bun run typecheck && cd ../electron && bun run typecheck
scripts.build: cd web && bun run build && cd ../electron && bun run build:main
